method: Each state-level value whose quote passed the strict citation check was read by hand against its quote (and page text where needed) and judged: is it this requirement, for this kind of practice, stated as a requirement?

criteria_notes.design_infiltration_rate_in_per_hr: Read as the minimum native-soil infiltration rate for infiltration practices; media rates, caps and assumptions excluded.
criteria_notes.permanent_pool_depth_inches: Read as the minimum permanent-pool depth; maxima and averages excluded.
